tool_args.rationale: The field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures favor a coupled dynamical model, but the pilot samples only five endpoints with H between 0.38 and 0.52. The extra trajectory batch is the only relevant probe on the menu and can help distinguish transient rates from memory and sink effects before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a coupled field–sink memory model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoints at similar horizons cannot reliably separate memory strength, sink coupling, and transient rates. The pilot also fixes u_past at 0.6 times u_now.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static Haldane, Cobb–Douglas, or barrier-modulated siphon law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These laws omit the initial state, memory, and horizon, so a good fit on this pilot would not explain the observed transient lag.
This probe does not resolve the ambiguity in the coupled dynamics.
